body: The jar contains ash beneath its lid, sealed with quarantine tape, a numbered evacuation tag tied at its neck—447. A photo ID lies beside it, edges charred, bearing the number 531 on a second tag. Both were collected during the same evacuation, logged by the same officer, yet given different numbers. The jar was sealed for transport while the ID was set aside.
title: Ash inside the sealed jar
